items.title: Monetization Gateway beta: charge AI agents for consumption with HTTP 402
items.summary: Cloudflare’s AI Gateway, Ceramic.ai, Stocktwits, and more are using the Cloudflare Monetization Gateway today to charge agents for access to tokens, APIs, and MCP tools. U.S.-based sellers can now apply for access to the closed beta.

items.title: Pay Per Use: when AI uses your work, you should get paid
items.summary: Pay Per Use is now in beta. AI companies report when they use publishers’ content, and Cloudflare handles billing, payouts, and reporting, so our customers are paid according to use.

items.title: Identify AI model overuse with User Insights
items.summary: AI Gateway User Insights now adds task, model, turn, and user categories to help teams understand AI adoption and make better model decisions. This is available free to AI Gateway users.

items.title: Cloudflare Containers, rebuilt to scale agent sandboxes
items.summary: Cloudflare Containers now start 6x faster, let your agent choose each sandbox's image and instance type at runtime, and support filesystem snapshots in public beta, all controlled from a Durable Object.

items.title: The Internet has a second audience
items.summary: More than half the traffic reaching sites on Cloudflare is now automated, and AI agents are the fastest-growing part of it. We're giving site owners the tools to see who's visiting, decide who gets in, and charge for access.

items.title: NBA The Run Kicks off its First Season with a Major Update
items.summary: Today,Wave One – 2000s Legends arrives as NBA The Run’s first seasonal update, the biggest one yet since launch in June. The update is free for all players and adds five historic NBA stars, two new gameplay cameras – Drive Cam & Drive Flip Cam, the Championship Belts to showcase your mastery, Licensed music, Practice

items.title: Game on: Henry Cavill is putting Googlebook to the test
items.summary: Henry Cavill is partnering with Googlebook to build a video game, coming this November.

items.title: Experience two artists’ perspectives on philosophy, science, and AI
items.summary: Artists Xin Liu and Eunjo Lee used Google AI to create new artworks with LAS Art Foundation and Google Arts & Culture Lab.

items.title: Google is a technology partner for the launch of America.gov.
items.summary: Google partners with America.gov to use Gemini to help 100 million people access federal services faster. See how we are modernizing public access.

items.title: How Control Resonant’s art design and tech shaped its bosses, paranaturally-twisted Manhattan and more
items.summary: With its gravity-defying set pieces, memorable boss fights, and decidedly different take on Manhattan, Control Resonant, released last week, is staking its claim to be one of 2026’s big hitters on PlayStation 5. I had the chance to talk to Lead Level Designer Anne-Marie Grönroos, Art Director Elmeri Raitanen, and Lead Gameplay Designer Sergey Mohov

items.title: Using AI to chart a course for our post-quantum migration
items.summary: We’re building CryptoLabe, an internal AI-powered tool that discovers cryptography across our codebase, surfaces dependencies, and helps us progress toward a full post-quantum migration by 2029. Here’s what we’ve learned so far.

items.title: Building a certificate authority for the whole Internet
items.summary: Twelve years after launching Universal SSL, Cloudflare is applying to become a certificate authority. By combining an established root, an ACME-first approach, and Merkle Tree Certificates, we are building a post-quantum CA for the open web.

items.title: New Microsoft data innovations unlock what only your business knows
items.summary: Every organization has knowledge that is uniquely its own: the way its business operates, the data it has built over time, the expertise of its people and the context behind thousands of everyday decisions.
